packageRules.description: Postgres stays on Neon's major version; bump it by hand together with Neon.
typescript-eslint supports TypeScript < 6.1; bump TypeScript's minor and major by hand.
engines are minimum versions, not pins. Keep them as ranges and move them by hand together with packageManager and .nvmrc.
A pnpm major changes the lockfile and settings; upgrade by hand, together with engines.pnpm.
